method.network: Owned ephemeral loopback port only; no tunnel; existing8765/8767 untouched
method.processAttribution: Exact unique disposable PATH prefix inherited in launchctl WebKit XPC domain (custom run env is sanitized), corroborated by prelaunch/exit PID+start snapshots; raw environment never persisted
method.memory: macOS vmmap per-task physical footprint/peak including compressed charges; chargedFootprintSumMiB is a sum of task accounting, not exact total system physical RAM. ps RSS is separate and includes shared resident mappings. Phase footprint measurements are sequential, not simultaneous.
method.timing: AppKit NSWindow.sendEvent keyDown/up, trusted DOM input, keydown/input to double requestAnimationFrame; native dispatch-to-JS completion includes IPC/callback overhead. Frames are compositor submission/presentation opportunity proxies, not photons. Peer barrier waits metadata/native editor length plus two normal animation frames.
method.allocation: Equal scalar-only WS/value/split/encoder/storage counters, no source retained by probes. WebKit has no exposed forced GC; all footprint retention checkpoints are natural. Chromium paired browser has separate natural and explicit-GC JS heap and DOM metrics.
method.instrumentation: Identical opt-in Metrics.swift local file controller, optimized wrapper, embedded host/assets untouched
method.providers: Disposable fake codex/claude; startup auth probes counted; AI fixture turn separate from core editor phases
method.safety: Serial phases; stop if owned WebContent RSS exceeds2GiB or owned native task RSS sum exceeds3GiB; physical footprint guard3GiB at checkpoints. One near-limit high-line document, no eight near-limit native stress allocation.

workload.scenarioDifferenceFromBroadHarness: Native suite uses one high-line near-limit document plus eight ordinary documents; does not claim to reproduce eight near-limit source workload. Paired Chromium phone cost reported separately.
